subject: engine/src/view (hayro 0.8.0 render and structured text) against MuPDF 1.28.1 (node mupdf, the app's engine)
fixtures: all 54 fixtures; render and per-page dimensions exclude large.pdf, text covers it too

commands.render: TPDF_PDF_PASSWORD=pdf4all-user node tools/compare-mupdf-pages.mjs target/release/examples/view_probe FILES (72 DPI)
commands.text: view_probe text FILE vs page.toStructuredText('preserve-whitespace').asText() and engine.ts parseLines(toStructuredText('preserve-spans').asJSON())
commands.search: view_probe search FILE PAGE NEEDLES vs page.search(needle, {}); needles are each page's words, lowercase variants, inner substrings, first word pairs and cross-line pairs

semanticsProbes: Generated pages (scratch, not kept) checked line, paragraph (indent over 0.5 pt), space synthesis (0.15 and 0.8 em), fake-bold, clip, mediabox, fill+stroke, invisible, marked-content, ActualText and search (hyphen joins, whitespace runs, line breaks, non-overlapping hits) behavior; the durable cases are in tests/view.rs.
knownDeviations: Text drawn only as a clip (Tr 7) is not extracted: hayro emits no glyph run for it. MuPDF extracts it.

ActualText alignment: shared prefix and suffix keep their glyphs, middle characters take middle glyphs in order. MuPDF differs in geometry (zero-width characters, extra synthetic spaces) when the first character matches; the text is the same in the fixtures.
Hits are one per match; MuPDF sometimes splits one match into several hits when its quads are not adjacent.
WinAnsi 0xA0 and 0xAD in non-embedded base-14 fonts read as U+00A0 and U+00AD (hayro's table); MuPDF reports space and hyphen. ZapfDingbats glyphs read U+FFFD (MuPDF returns control characters).
MCIDs inside form XObjects get no structure-tree ActualText.

Bare CFF and Type1 embedded programs: ascender/descender come from the FontDescriptor or default to 0.8/-0.2; style flags from descriptor flags. Type3 glyphs use 0.8/-0.2 and advances from glyph spacing.
Vertical writing (Identity-V) is laid out as horizontal text.
Degenerate page boxes (empty or disjoint CropBox) get MuPDF's pixel size, but hayro clips content to its own crop box.

NoView annotations are hidden by patching their /F digits in a private copy of the bytes; annotations in object streams or with indirect /F are still drawn. Invisible-flag and optional-content-hidden annotations are drawn.
